what: A 12 columns × 6 rows grid is laid over a strip at the bottom of the section (height set by the user), and from when the section tail touches the bottom of the screen until it leaves the top, it is bound to scroll (scrub .3) and cells switch on one by one, covering with the next section’s colour. The order is set by lower rows first (50 per row) + 0~300 random + a sin wave of 30 per column, with each cell’s .1 duration spread across a total of 1.5. With reveal, the cover switches off in the same order while the section head travels from below the screen to the center. Below widths 991, 767 and 478 the columns are reduced to .75x, .6x and .4x

options.mode: cover (default — off cells turn on and cover) · reveal (on cells turn off and reveal)
options.start: Start position, default cover “bottom bottom” · reveal “top bottom” (relative to the section)
options.end: End position, default cover ”bottom top” · reveal ”top center”

use: …

from.where: index.html .jg-pixels (About → black process section, process section → light client section — original pixelated-scroll-transition: 12 columns · 6 rows · band height 37.5vw · scrub .3 · cell .1 · stagger amount 1.5)
news.html·about.html header photo section end (.pxc, data-columns 16 · tablet 10 · mobile 6 · rows 6) — same order (row 50 + 0~300 + sin 30) · scrub .3 · .1/1.5

note: Cells are filled with currentColor — give the next section’s background color as the element’s color. Since the strip overlaps the previous section, give the section position: relative and a bottom margin (about .75 of the strip height)
